说明：层级值取 BOM 的物料层级 `bm_lvl`（"产品装配层级中的级别"）。直接组件为层级 2（该车架本身位于第 1 层），嵌套件为层级 3、4。

最终 SQL：

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE bom_tree AS (
  SELECT b.ref2 AS component_id, b.bm_lvl AS level
  FROM bom b
  JOIN prod r ON b.ref3 = r.prdc_id
  WHERE r.nm = 'HL Road Frame - Black, 58' AND b.end_dt IS NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT b.ref2, b.bm_lvl
  FROM bom b
  JOIN bom_tree t ON b.ref3 = t.component_id
  WHERE b.end_dt IS NULL
)
SELECT t.level, p.nm AS component_name
FROM bom_tree t
JOIN prod p ON p.prdc_id = t.component_id
ORDER BY t.level, p.nm;
```
